documentation.content: One report cost more than $0.04. Normal is $0.005-0.015 (10/9-10/21). Usually a tool loop or a huge tool result; the dashboard's per-model-call breakdown shows which.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="gameday-report" AND jsonPayload.event="report" AND jsonPayload.dry_run=false AND jsonPayload.total_cost_usd>0.04
